  • Method Details

    • getTelemetry

      public AM_CAN_HexBoreEncoder.AM_Encoder_Telemetry getTelemetry(int timeoutMs)
      Refresh & return the latest telemetry snapshot.

      Frame layout (8 bytes, little-endian multi-byte fields): 

       [0..1] u16 angle_zeroed_counts
 [2..3] i16 velocity_counts_per_s
 [4..5] u16 magnitude
 [6]    u8  diag_err
 [7]    u8  seq
      Parameters:
      timeoutMs - timeout for receive
      Returns:
      cached Telemetry (updated if a frame arrived)

    • getTelemetry

      Overload with a default timeout.

    • getStatus

      public AM_CAN_HexBoreEncoder.AM_EncoderStatus getStatus(int timeoutMs)
      Refresh & return the latest status snapshot.

      Frame layout (8 bytes, little-endian multi-byte fields): 

       [0..1] u16 angle_offset_cd
 [2]    u8  agc
 [3]    u8  diag_misc
 [4..5] u16 raw_angle_comp
 [6..7] u16 errfl
      Parameters:
      timeoutMs - timeout for receive
      Returns:
      cached Status (updated if a frame arrived)
